formalizations.result: a relative cubical loop induces a map of pairs whose relative-homology action is invariant under relative homotopy; evaluation therefore descends to relative homotopy classes and is natural, while the oriented top class of the cube pair defines a natural relative Hurewicz comparison in every degree at least two
formalizations.model_relation: the maintained cubical relative homotopy groups, based maps of pairs, integer relative singular homology, and the standard disk-to-cube identification with sphere boundary
formalizations.note: All twenty listed declarations are sorry-free Lean 4. Audited axiom closures contain only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. This constructs the previously missing natural comparison map and its canonical oriented input; proving that comparison bijective in the first nonvanishing degree remains necessary before any exact homotopy-group cell can be recolored.

formalizations.result: the bounded singular-simplex compression theorem is packaged directly for n-connected pairs, giving relative-homology vanishing through degree n and the corresponding inclusion isomorphism/epimorphism ranges; the two sphere cap pairs and the excised sphere/upper-cap target satisfy this complete vanishing range
formalizations.model_relation: the maintained IsNConnectedPair structure, coherent singular-simplex compression, relative singular homology, and exact sphere-cap cover used by the suspension-excision route

formalizations.result: the homology sequence of a pair is natural for maps of pairs; for any two subsets whose interiors cover the ambient space, the canonical map H_k(A,A∩B) to H_k(X,B) is an isomorphism in every degree; for the explicit sphere-cap cover this is exactly the canonical map underlying suspension excision, and both top relative groups are identified with Z
